issue_read.title: Make `projects` toolset part of the default toolsets

189: // ToolOption configures how tools are built. Options carry deployment
190: // capabilities that are known when the inventory is constructed, so a tool's
191: // description and its behaviour are decided from the same value and cannot
192: // drift apart.
193: type ToolOption func(*toolConfig)
194: 
195: type toolConfig struct {
196: 	// hostType is the deployment the tools will talk to. The zero value is
197: 	// dotcom, which is also what an empty GITHUB_HOST resolves to.
198: 	hostType utils.HostType
199: }

201: // WithHost tells the tools which deployment they will talk to, so those with
202: // host-specific capabilities can adapt. Derive it from utils.ParseHostType.
203: func WithHost(h utils.HostType) ToolOption {
204: 	return func(c *toolConfig) { c.hostType = h }
205: }

207: func newToolConfig(opts []ToolOption) toolConfig {
208: 	var cfg toolConfig

412: // GenerateToolsetsHelp generates the help text for the toolsets flag
413: func GenerateToolsetsHelp() string {
414: 	// Get toolset group to derive defaults and available toolsets
415: 	// Build() can only fail if WithTools specifies invalid tools - not used here
416: 	r, _ := NewInventory(stubTranslator).Build()
417: 
418: 	// Format default tools from metadata using strings.Builder
419: 	var defaultBuf strings.Builder
420: 	defaultIDs := r.DefaultToolsetIDs()
421: 	for i, id := range defaultIDs {
422: 		if i > 0 {
423: 			defaultBuf.WriteString(", ")
424: 		}
425: 		defaultBuf.WriteString(string(id))
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	// Get all available toolsets (excludes context for display)
429: 	allToolsets := r.AvailableToolsets("context")
430: 	var availableBuf strings.Builder
431: 	const maxLineLength = 70
432: 	currentLine := ""
433: 
434: 	for i, toolset := range allToolsets {
435: 		id := string(toolset.ID)
436: 		switch {
437: 		case i == 0:
438: 			currentLine = id
439: 		case len(currentLine)+len(id)+2 <= maxLineLength:
440: 			currentLine += ", " + id
441: 		default:
442: 			if availableBuf.Len() > 0 {
443: 				availableBuf.WriteString(",\n\t     ")
444: 			}
445: 			availableBuf.WriteString(currentLine)
446: 			currentLine = id
447: 		}
448: 	}
449: 	if currentLine != "" {
450: 		if availableBuf.Len() > 0 {
451: 			availableBuf.WriteString(",\n\t     ")
452: 		}
453: 		availableBuf.WriteString(currentLine)
454: 	}
455: 
456: 	// Build the complete help text using strings.Builder
457: 	var buf strings.Builder
458: 	buf.WriteString("Comma-separated list of tool groups to enable (no spaces).\n")
459: 	buf.WriteString("Available: ")
460: 	buf.WriteString(availableBuf.String())
461: 	buf.WriteString("\n")
462: 	buf.WriteString("Special toolset keywords:\n")
463: 	buf.WriteString("  - all: Enables all available toolsets\n")
464: 	buf.WriteString("  - default: Enables the default toolset configuration of:\n\t     ")
465: 	buf.WriteString(defaultBuf.String())
466: 	buf.WriteString("\n")
467: 	buf.WriteString("Examples:\n")
468: 	buf.WriteString("  - --toolsets=actions,gists,notifications\n")
469: 	buf.WriteString("  - Default + additional: --toolsets=default,actions,gists\n")
470: 	buf.WriteString("  - All tools: --toolsets=all")
471: 
472: 	return buf.String()
473: }

475: // stubTranslator is a passthrough translator for cases where we need an Inventory
476: // but don't need actual translations (e.g., getting toolset IDs for CLI help).
477: func stubTranslator(_, fallback string) string { return fallback }
478: 
479: // AddDefaultToolset removes the default toolset and expands it to the actual default toolset IDs
480: func AddDefaultToolset(result []string) []string {
481: 	hasDefault := false
482: 	seen := make(map[string]bool)
483: 	for _, toolset := range result {
484: 		seen[toolset] = true
485: 		if toolset == string(ToolsetMetadataDefault.ID) {
486: 			hasDefault = true
487: 		}
488: 	}
489: 
490: 	// Only expand if "default" keyword was found
491: 	if !hasDefault {
492: 		return result
493: 	}
494: 
495: 	result = RemoveToolset(result, string(ToolsetMetadataDefault.ID))
496: 
497: 	// Get default toolset IDs from the Inventory
498: 	// Build() can only fail if WithTools specifies invalid tools - not used here
499: 	r, _ := NewInventory(stubTranslator).Build()
500: 	for _, id := range r.DefaultToolsetIDs() {
501: 		if !seen[string(id)] {
502: 			result = append(result, string(id))
503: 		}
504: 	}
505: 	return result
506: }
507: 
508: func RemoveToolset(tools []string, toRemove string) []string {
509: 	result := make([]string, 0, len(tools))
510: 	for _, tool := range tools {
511: 		if tool != toRemove {
512: 			result = append(result, tool)
513: 		}
514: 	}
515: 	return result
516: }

518: func ContainsToolset(tools []string, toCheck string) bool {
519: 	return slices.Contains(tools, toCheck)

522: // CleanTools cleans tool names by removing duplicates and trimming whitespace.
523: // Validation of tool existence is done during registration.
524: func CleanTools(toolNames []string) []string {
525: 	seen := make(map[string]bool)
526: 	result := make([]string, 0, len(toolNames))
527: 
528: 	// Remove duplicates and trim whitespace
529: 	for _, tool := range toolNames {
530: 		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(tool)
531: 		if trimmed == "" {
532: 			continue
533: 		}
534: 		if !seen[trimmed] {
535: 			seen[trimmed] = true
536: 			result = append(result, trimmed)
537: 		}
538: 	}
539: 
540: 	return result
541: }
